items.title: Reporting Verb বদল (say / tell)
items.body:
The man said, “I am tired.” → The man said that he was tired.
The girl said to me, “I like books.” → The girl told me that she liked books.
items.topic: পর্ব ১ — সাধারণ নিয়ম — Reporting verb • Person • Tense • সময়/স্থান

items.title: Pronoun (Person) বদল
items.body:
He said to me, “I have enjoyed the party.” → He told me that he had enjoyed…
He tells Karim, “You are lucky.” → He tells Karim that he is lucky.
items.topic: পর্ব ১ — সাধারণ নিয়ম — Reporting verb • Person • Tense • সময়/স্থান

items.title: Tense বদল
items.body:
Tanvir said, “I write a letter.” → …that he wrote a letter.
Aminur said, “I wrote…” → …that he had written…
Salma said, “I may go” → …she might go.
items.topic: পর্ব ১ — সাধারণ নিয়ম — Reporting verb • Person • Tense • সময়/স্থান

items.title: সময় ও স্থানের শব্দ বদল
items.body: Rony said to Salma, “I shall meet you here tomorrow.” → Rony told Salma that he would meet her there the next day.
items.topic: পর্ব ১ — সাধারণ নিয়ম — Reporting verb • Person • Tense • সময়/স্থান

items.title: Assertive Sentence (বিবৃতিমূলক বাক্য)
items.body: He said to her, “I shall come tomorrow.” → He told her that he would go the next day.
items.topic: পর্ব ২ — বাক্যের ধরন অনুযায়ী — Assertive • Interrogative • Imperative • Optative • Exclamatory

items.title: Interrogative Sentence (প্রশ্নবোধক বাক্য)
items.body: Tina said to her sister, “Will you go to market?” → Tina asked her sister if she would go to market.
items.topic: পর্ব ২ — বাক্যের ধরন অনুযায়ী — Assertive • Interrogative • Imperative • Optative • Exclamatory

items.title: Imperative Sentence (আদেশ / অনুরোধ / উপদেশ)
items.body: The Headmaster said to the students, “Do not tell a lie.” → The Headmaster advised the students not to tell a lie.
items.topic: পর্ব ২ — বাক্যের ধরন অনুযায়ী — Assertive • Interrogative • Imperative • Optative • Exclamatory

items.title: Optative Sentence (কামনা / প্রার্থনা)
items.body: He said to me, “May Allah bless you.” → He prayed that Allah might bless me.
items.topic: পর্ব ২ — বাক্যের ধরন অনুযায়ী — Assertive • Interrogative • Imperative • Optative • Exclamatory

items.title: Exclamatory Sentence (বিস্ময়সূচক বাক্য)
items.body: Sraban said, “What a wonderful bird it is!” → Sraban exclaimed with surprise that it was a very wonderful bird.
items.topic: পর্ব ২ — বাক্যের ধরন অনুযায়ী — Assertive • Interrogative • Imperative • Optative • Exclamatory

items.title: Must ও বিশেষ শব্দ (Thank you, Good-bye…)
items.body:
Sujata said, “I must write.” → …that she had to write.
He said to him, “Good morning.” → He wished him good morning.
items.topic: পর্ব ৩ — অতিরিক্ত নিয়ম — Must, বিশেষ শব্দ ও Passage Narration
